eval_render_note: EVAL RENDER: feed `prompt` verbatim as plain text, NO chat template (directed-modulation is the only chat-templated family). `gate_variant` records how the item was behaviorally verified and does NOT affect the eval read.
read: the last word of the prompt (its last non-whitespace token; one position per item, every judged layer); changed 2026-09-23 from the final prompt token, which for 33 items is the bare space after the last word (Camila: "multihop should be read on the second to last token, ie the last word, not the space token"). Per item, `readout.offsets` is the read position counted from the end of the Qwen3.6-27B tokenization of `prompt`: -2 for the 33 prompts that end in a bare space token, -1 for the 67 whose final token is the word itself (59) or the opening quote of `is "` (8: the quote is the last non-whitespace token and is the read).
